subject.title: fix(codex): prefer recovered replies over stale failure banners

question: Should failed Codex conversation turns be overridden by any collected streamed text, or only by completed assistant-message evidence?
rationale: The code repair is straightforward, but accepting partial streamed deltas as a user-visible replacement for a failed turn is a product/message-delivery decision because it can trade stale failure banners for incomplete replies.

options.title: Require Completed Assistant Evidence
options.body: Suppress a failed-turn error only when an `item/completed` assistant message or completed turn item proves a final assistant answer exists.

options.title: Accept Partial Delta Delivery
options.body: Allow any streamed assistant delta to replace the failure banner, accepting the risk of incomplete replies when a turn fails fatally after partial output.

options.title: Pause For Codex Contract Clarification
options.body: Wait for upstream Codex to expose a clearer recovered-versus-fatal completion signal before changing OpenClaw's user-visible failed-turn behavior.

recommendation.title: Require Completed Assistant Evidence
recommendation.body: Suppress a failed-turn error only when an `item/completed` assistant message or completed turn item proves a final assistant answer exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent adjacent Codex app-server and conversation-binding work is under this account, and this choice spans Codex protocol interpretation plus user-visible delivery policy.
